Date: Monday 16 Nov 2026, 1-6pm
Venue: WYSE, Perennial Business City (near Jurong East MRT)
Before 12:30 PM: Team Registration / Check-in
12:30–12:45 PM: Change & Warm-up
12:45–1:00 PM: Welcome & Tournament briefing
1:00 PM sharp: First Matches Start
~4:45–5:30 PM: Medal Matches
5:30–6:00 PM: 🏆 Closing & Prize Ceremony
All players must attend the initial briefing and closing ceremony. Please arrive early and be ready for the first matches to start promptly at 1:00 PM.

The tournament follows a Single-Elimination Knockout format. The two losing semifinalists will compete for third place.
Match format: 1 game per match. First team to 30 points wins. No deuce / no extension. The match ends immediately when one team reaches 30 points, even if 30-29. The teams will change ends when the first team reaches 15 points, with a 1-minute break interval before play resumes. Pre-match warm up is strictly limited to 2 minutes on the assigned match court
Withdrawals & Walkovers: If a team withdraws before its match, the opponent may receive a walkover (W/O). Vacant positions in the draw may become byes. A replacement partner may be allowed before the team's first match, subject to organizer approval. Once a team has started playing in the tournament, player substitution will not be allowed.
Line Judge & Umpire Duty: Players who have just completed a match are required to stay back to support the next match as line judges (2), umpire (1) and service umpire (1). Please do not leave the court area immediately after your match until you have been released from this duty. Umpire reports the result via QR code or to the Organizer’s desk immediately after each game.
Practice Court/Friendly Games: On courts available for practice or friendly games, play to 11 points to allow more players to participate. Please use used shuttlecocks for warm-up and practice. New shuttlecocks are reserved for official matches.
Please check the tournament website or TV display regularly for practice court availability and upcoming matches. Players listed under Next Up should prepare to play as soon as their court becomes available.

Footwear: Non-marking badminton shoes are required when using the courts.
Food & Drinks: Food is not permitted inside the venue. A water cooler is available.
Air Conditioning: The venue is air-conditioned and may feel cold. Consider bringing a jacket.
Please review the WYSE Active Hub House Rules before the event.
